name: lut_user
description: QA consumer for the resource-handle convention (doc 14 appendix): its xi.pack@1 door builds a demo.lut via the demo.lut.build capability (host-forwarded, provided by the lut_owner TYPE-OWNER lib instance), forwards the handle entry {type,id,gen,$v} VERBATIM in its output pack (how a handle rides packs across a door hop), queries via demo.lut.query with either a just-built or a script-forwarded handle, and materializes via demo.lut.dump — surfacing funnel rcs and $fault codes to the script.
